faq.subtitle: Still have questions? Write to us — we typically respond within 24 hours on business days.

items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge to work with you?
items.a: No technical knowledge is required. We handle all setup, integration, and logic. In some cases, you may need to provide access credentials or API keys — we'll walk you through this process step by step with clear, written instructions. Everything is explained simply and in writing.

We work 100% asynchronously — no calls, no video meetings. You fill out a brief description of the task, we ask clarifying questions in writing, and keep you updated at every stage. No time is wasted on planning. Everything is documented and easy to return to. Most clients find it faster and more convenient than working with traditional agencies.

items.q: What tools do I need before starting work?
items.a: It depends on the service. For simple integrations, a Google account is usually sufficient. For Vipps + Fiken automation, you will need an active Vipps Business account and a Fiken subscription. For CRM setup, we will help you choose and configure the appropriate system. We always check what you already have before starting — nothing is assumed, and nothing extra is required.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Simple integrations: 3–5 business days. Vipps + Fiken automation: 5–7 business days. CRM or chatbot setup: 5–10 business days. Landing page + lead generation: 5–10 business days. The timeframe begins when we receive your deposit and all necessary access. Delays in providing access or feedback may extend the timeframe.

Most clients save 5–10 hours per week and significantly reduce errors related to manual work. Exact results depend on your processes — we set realistic expectations during the initial audit. Our goal is simple: less routine, more flow.
50% deposit before work begins, 50% upon delivery. Payment is accepted via Vipps or bank transfer. We send an official payment confirmation for every transaction. No hidden fees.

items.q: What happens if something stops working after delivery?
items.a: We provide a 30-day free bug-fixing period after delivery. If something breaks due to our implementation, we'll fix it at no cost. Problems caused by third-party tools or client-side changes are addressed separately or as part of a support plan.

items.q: Can you work with tools not listed on your website?
items.a: Yes. We focus on the most common tools, but we regularly work with custom stacks and less common platforms. If a tool has an API, it can be integrated in most cases. You can describe your setup in the audit form, and we'll confirm whether this is possible.
